name: Four Seasons Resort Vail
insider_take: Nestled at 8,200 feet elevation, this ski-in/ski-out sanctuary sits directly on Vail Mountain with unparalleled access to Colorado's legendary Back Bowls.
whats_special: The resort features the largest spa in Vail at 14,000 square feet, complete with outdoor relaxation terraces that offer panoramic mountain views. It's also the only luxury hotel in Vail with direct slope access to both the front side runs and the famous Blue Sky Basin.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the spa's outdoor hot tubs during snowfall for an unforgettable alpine wellness experience, and request a mountain-view room on floors 5-7 for the best sunrise views over the Gore Range.
dont_miss: The resort's signature hot chocolate service delivered slopeside, and evening s'mores by the outdoor fire pits while watching the mountain's evening alpenglow. The nearby Betty Ford Alpine Gardens (seasonal) offers the world's highest botanical garden at 8,200 feet elevation.
pros: Prime ski-in/ski-out location with direct Vail Mountain access
Exceptional luxury spa and wellness facilities
World-class Four Seasons service and amenities
Stunning mountain views and alpine setting
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Seasonal availability with peak winter demand
